blurb: Guests join dolphin tours aboard the 70-foot Sea Racer, cruising through the Intracoastal Waterway and Atlantic Ocean near Myrtle Beach and Little River. Tours offer opportunities to see Atlantic bottlenose dolphins and other marine life in their natural habitat. The experience includes narration by the captain and photo opportunities.
